capabilities: Show remaining reading time in the status bar
Show reading progress as a percentage
Update the estimate in real time based on cursor position
Enable the display on Obsidian mobile
disambiguation: Unlike the Reading Time plugin it is based on, it targets readers tracking progress through a text, not writers managing note length.
extras: The mobile setup instructions rely on an animated demo that is stripped from the plain-text README, so that part of the documentation is effectively missing.
intentEvidence: this version is designed for a different use case — reading
motivation: The author wanted a version of the Reading Time plugin optimized for reading and pacing reading sessions rather than for writing and keeping notes concise.
problem: The Reading Time plugin measures total note length for writers, but gives readers no sense of how much time is left to finish the note they are currently reading.

relations.evidence: This plugin is based on great reading-time plugin, which focuses primarily on writing

summary: Status bar indicator that shows the remaining reading time and reading progress percentage for the current note based on cursor position.
